title: EPR + De Minimis Tariff Compliance Dataset
description: Schema for the epr_compliance dataset (v0.1). Two record types share the same array: packaging_epr (extended producer responsibility for packaging waste) and de_minimis_tariff (low-value import tariff thresholds). Geographic scope: EU (DE/FR/IT/ES/NL) + UK + US. English fields are master; Japanese fields are localized views. Discriminated by the record_type const.

schema_version.description: Semantic-ish version of this dataset schema (e.g. "0.1").

tri_state.description: Tri-state allowance flag with explicit unknown.

confidence_level.description: Confidence in the correctness of the record at last_checked_at.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (uppercase). "ZZ" is reserved for skeleton placeholders.

record.description: An EPR or tariff record. Discriminated by record_type via oneOf.

id.description: Stable record identifier, e.g. "epr_de_packaging". Lowercase 2-letter country code embedded.

regulation_name_en.description: Official regulation name. Original-language name preferred (e.g. "VerpackG", "Triman").

registration_url.description: Primary canonical URL for registration / official guidance.

covered_categories.description: Packaging materials covered by the regulation.

marketplace_liability.description: Whether the marketplace operator (e.g. Amazon, Etsy) bears compliance liability for non-registered sellers.

penalties_en.description: Penalty range / structure as stated by the source. Preserve original currency and verbatim phrasing where possible.

source_urls.description: All source URLs cited for this record. The first SHOULD match registration_url.

last_checked_at.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the record was last verified against official sources.

threshold_value.description: De minimis threshold value (numeric). "null" if the regime has no de minimis or the threshold is unknown.

threshold_value_jpy_estimate.description: Approximate JPY equivalent at the time of last_checked_at. Sourced from a generic FX rate; not authoritative.

applies_to_categories.description: Goods categories the threshold applies to. Default "all_goods" if no carve-outs.

vat_above_threshold.description: Whether VAT (or sales tax equivalent) is owed once the import value exceeds the threshold.

duty_above_threshold.description: Whether import duty (tariff) is owed once the import value exceeds the threshold.

special_regimes.description: Voluntary or simplified regimes that apply at or below the threshold (e.g. "IOSS" for EU < EUR 150, "OSS" for intra-EU distance sales).

reporting_burden_en.description: Free-text summary of declaration / VAT-collection burden. Preserve original phrasing.

current_state.description: Operational state of the rule as of as_of date. status is derived from the most recent relevant timeline event; see SKILL.md §2 rule 18.

status.description: Operational status of the rule as of as_of date. active = in normal force; suspended = temporarily halted; scheduled_for_removal = official phase-out announced; removed = fully repealed; unknown = state not determinable.

as_of.description: Date when the status was last verified.

timeline.description: Append-only event log for this rule. Sorted descending by date (most recent at index 0). Sort order is enforced by extraction logic, not schema. The first record (chronologically) MUST be an initial_verification event.

date.description: Date the event occurred or was announced.

description_en.description: 1-2 sentence factual description in English. Verbatim phrasing from source preferred where it preserves meaning.

description_ja.description: Japanese gloss of description_en. Optional but recommended for major events.

source_url.description: Single canonical source for this specific event. Must be a primary source (government release, official announcement, legislative document, or executive order) — not a news article.

value_before.description: Optional: prior value (e.g. previous threshold, previous fee). For numeric continuity changes only — do not use for status or qualitative changes.

value_after.description: Optional: new value. For numeric continuity changes only — do not use for status or qualitative changes.
